task_label: TASK-M6C.1 decouple Websearch provider coercion from ToolExecutor
acceptance_criteria: With TRANSPORT_WEBSEARCH_DECOUPLED absent or false, preserve the existing system.websearch executor behavior.
With the flag true, ToolExecutor no longer owns Websearch-specific provider/model coercion and the existing Websearch boundary receives the required request context.
Preserve provider/model compatibility and cross-provider safety without changing gateways, transports, schemas, streaming, ToolLoopRunner, or unrelated tools.
Add hermetic focused regressions only in the allowlisted test files and do not use network credentials.
